import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp');from widest import widest_plan
from build_case import build
# Need variant accepting order. Modify function quickly by source exec
src=open('tmp/widest.py').read()
src=src.replace('def widest_plan(H,participants,roots):','def widest_plan(H,participants,roots,order=None):')
src=src.replace('    for rv in P:','    for rv in (order if order is not None else P):')
ns={};exec(src,ns);wp=ns['widest_plan']
for n,numtrees in [(24,60),(32,100)]:
 H,roots=build(n,numtrees)
 orders=[]
 orders.append(sorted(roots,key=lambda u:roots[u]))
 orders.append(sorted(roots,key=lambda u:-roots[u]))
 random.seed(0)
 for _ in range(100):o=list(roots);random.shuffle(o);orders.append(o)
 succ=0;best=None;t=time.time()
 for o in orders:
  recs,cap=wp(H,list(range(n)),roots,o)
  if recs is not None:
   succ+=1;best=len(recs);break
 print(n,'succ',succ,'best',best,'time',time.time()-t)
